Title: REST based Client library and PowerShell module in preview

Body.Content:
The REST based client library and PowerShell modules give you access to connect to and manage your cluster without installing the full Service Fabric SDK.

See here for details. This library is useful for example in DevOps build and deployment scenarios where the Service Fabric SDK cannot be installed.

Learn more about Azure Service Fabric.
